page.overview:
Who is Warriors?

The Warriors are a group of heroes from the dimension of Ebrik, and friends of Kirby and Donatello. They first appear in the 2003 TV series episode "The King" and later in the Battle Nexus Tournament.

In the 2003 animated series the warriors of Ebrik, as well as the rest of the world, are a creation of Kirby and the intensive use of the Warp Crystal. In this incarnation, the designs of the warriors is strongly inspired by the drawings of the original Jack Kirby, particularly in terms of the world of Asgard, which he created for Marvel Comics.
